summary: Scout discovery is implemented. Daily automation and evidence-grounded resume preparation are the next stages.

stages.title: Discover jobs
stages.description: Find roles that match your search preferences.
stages.next: Use Discover to search real roles and tune your keywords.

stages.title: Check & rank
stages.description: Combine duplicates, inspect sources and explain each result.
stages.next: Inspect application evidence and unknowns before shortlisting.

stages.title: Project foundation
stages.description: Private access, working controls and progress visibility.
stages.next: Finish visual QA and add durable usage budgets before unattended runs.

stages.title: Run every day
stages.description: Find new and changed jobs while your browser is closed.
stages.next: Build persistent job storage, then scheduling and run history.

stages.title: Know your experience
stages.description: Create an approved career profile supported by evidence.
stages.next: Add private document storage, ingest your master resume and confirm facts.

stages.title: Assess your fit
stages.description: Compare job requirements with your actual experience.
stages.next: Extract requirements and build a requirement-to-evidence comparison.

stages.title: Prepare a resume
stages.description: Draft a truthful tailored resume and check its document structure.
stages.next: Choose a model connection, then add drafting and validation.

stages.title: Review & apply
stages.description: Approve application packages and track what happened.
stages.next: Build a review queue and record the exact resume used for each application.

tasks.title: Keenable discovery
tasks.detail: Keenable is the actual search provider. Each batch runs up to four queries with up to 15 hits per query.
tasks.evidence: Hosted Portfolio Analyst / USA search passed on October 24.
tasks.acceptance: Find real individual role leads through the server-side provider connection.

tasks.title: Editable related roles
tasks.detail: Exact, Related and Broad modes; curated suggestions can be edited or removed. Custom occupations remain searchable.
tasks.evidence: Role expansion, custom terms and typo-boundary regression tests.
tasks.acceptance: Original titles rank ahead of related and broader terms.

tasks.title: Required and excluded keywords
tasks.detail: Require every listed phrase, exclude any listed phrase, and optionally match role keywords in descriptions.
tasks.evidence: ALL / ANY keyword and token-boundary tests.
tasks.acceptance: Apply phrase filters without executing user-provided regex.

tasks.title: Location and remote eligibility
tasks.detail: Recognizes country aliases, US states and common cities. Explicit applicant restrictions take precedence over an office address.
tasks.evidence: USA aliases, city/state and remote Canada-only regressions.
tasks.acceptance: Keep uncertainty explicit; exclude known geographic conflicts.

tasks.title: Level, work type, salary and age
tasks.detail: Filter seniority, arrangement, employment, compensation and employer posting age. Unknown facts are configurable; currencies and periods are not silently converted.
tasks.acceptance: Use job evidence rather than infer missing pay or dates.

tasks.title: Sponsorship evidence
tasks.detail: Shows explicit support, negatives and unknowns. Preference gives positive evidence a small boost; negatives remain visible.
tasks.evidence: Sponsorship extraction tests and hosted paste-import check.
tasks.acceptance: Show the source sentence and preserve unknown sponsorship.

tasks.title: Individual vacancies only
tasks.detail: Filters general directories and explicit non-vacancies. Individual links in directory snippets may become unverified leads.
tasks.evidence: Misleading board, directory and non-vacancy regressions.
tasks.acceptance: Avoid presenting a general job board as an individual vacancy.

tasks.title: Duplicate merging and source links
tasks.detail: Shares canonical URL, ATS identity and conservative evidence rules within and across batches. Keeps distinct known requisitions and locations.
tasks.evidence: Duplicate/source tests and mocked cross-batch UI checks.
tasks.acceptance: Prefer employer links and retain the supporting source copies.

tasks.title: Availability evidence
tasks.detail: Up to ten live checks per batch. Readable job/application evidence, unverified leads and explicit closure are distinct labels.
tasks.evidence: Hosted search showed three application pages and excluded a known closed listing.
tasks.acceptance: An unreadable or unchecked page must not be labeled closed or confirmed available.

tasks.title: Separate job and search dates
tasks.detail: Employer posting date, webpage publication date, index date and checked date remain distinct.
tasks.evidence: Index-date versus posting-age and expiry tests.
tasks.acceptance: A newly indexed old listing must not appear newly posted.

tasks.title: Explainable relevance ranking
tasks.detail: Original title phrases start at 1000, related at 700, broader at 500; description matches start at 80–180. Small preference bonuses apply. These are relevance points, not resume-fit percentages.
tasks.acceptance: Show why a role appeared and which facts remain unknown.

tasks.title: Streaming, refresh and cancellation
tasks.detail: Progressive results, cancellation, five-minute caching, explicit refresh and three distinct query batches. Cache expiry does not start a search by itself.
tasks.evidence: 15 hosted checks included streaming and zero-call cache reuse; nine mocked UI cases passed.
tasks.acceptance: Preserve partial results, reject stale responses and avoid automatic paid retries.

tasks.title: Private access and protected key
tasks.detail: The site remains owner-private. The provider key is a hosted server secret; the browser receives configuration status only.
tasks.evidence: Anonymous API returned 401; exact secret scan found zero leaks.
tasks.acceptance: Keep provider credentials out of source, bundles and API responses.

tasks.title: Bounded requests and safe imports
tasks.detail: Same-origin JSON requests, size/time limits, public URL validation, fixed provider host and no credential-forwarding redirects.
tasks.evidence: Hosted origin, content-type, body-size and private-URL checks passed.
tasks.acceptance: Limit each batch to four searches and ten page checks.

tasks.title: Imports, shortlist and export
tasks.detail: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and structured-page imports; paste fallback; 30 imports and 30 shortlisted snapshots in this browser; JSON export.
tasks.evidence: Existing import tests and hosted unverified paste/sponsorship check.
tasks.acceptance: Keep imported and saved evidence inspectable and portable.

tasks.title: Live project progress view
tasks.detail: Interactive workflow, task filters, dependencies, validation history and automatic record refresh. Status is reviewed with each implementation release.
tasks.evidence: Five record/dependency tests and ten mocked UI cases passed; local page and progress endpoint returned 200.
tasks.acceptance: Show completed and pending work from the same reviewed record.

tasks.title: Complete release validation
tasks.detail: Search release passed 64 automated tests, type checking, production build and 15 hosted checks. A fresh visual browser review remains outstanding.
tasks.evidence: October 24 release reports; browser automation was unavailable.
tasks.acceptance: Verify desktop/mobile layout, keyboard navigation and complete search/import flows in a real browser.

tasks.title: Durable daily usage budget
tasks.detail: Current rate guards are per Worker instance. Add account-wide daily provider/model budgets and visible spending limits before unattended use.
tasks.acceptance: Repeated runs cannot bypass the daily cap; API calls and reported credits stay distinct.

tasks.title: Persistent job and preference storage
tasks.detail: Store jobs, preferences, source snapshots and run state on the server, beyond browser-local storage.
tasks.acceptance: History survives browser changes, Worker replacement and deployment.

tasks.title: Authenticated daily runner
tasks.detail: Run searches when the website is closed, with a selected timezone and overlap protection.
tasks.acceptance: An authenticated background run completes without an open browser and respects the budget.

tasks.title: New and changed job detection
tasks.detail: Track first-seen, last-checked and job-description changes. Newly discovered is different from newly posted.
tasks.acceptance: Show new, changed, previously seen and confirmed closed jobs without repeating them as new.

tasks.title: Run history, recovery and alerts
tasks.detail: Durable run records, limited retries, duplicate-run protection and visible failures.
tasks.acceptance: Interrupted or overlapping runs do not duplicate records or silently consume unlimited calls.

tasks.title: Daily job digest
tasks.detail: Deliver the selected new/changed jobs with evidence and a record of what was sent.
tasks.acceptance: Send only the authorized digest, track delivery and avoid duplicate notifications.

tasks.title: Private career document storage
tasks.detail: Private resume/evidence files with access, retention and deletion controls.
tasks.acceptance: Only authorized access can retrieve the career documents; deletion and versions are traceable.

tasks.title: Read your master resume
tasks.detail: Extract employment, projects, education and skills, with the source for each fact.
tasks.acceptance: Retain dates and factual evidence; ask about unclear or missing information.

tasks.title: Approve your factual career profile
tasks.detail: Confirm the experience ledger before a model uses it for tailored resumes.
tasks.acceptance: Every approved skill, qualification and achievement has supporting evidence.

tasks.title: Extract job requirements
tasks.detail: Read a sufficiently complete job description and separate required, preferred and unclear qualifications.
tasks.acceptance: Each requirement links to a job-description sentence; incomplete excerpts are held for review.

tasks.title: Compare requirements with your evidence
tasks.detail: Mark each requirement supported, unmet or unknown and explain gaps. This is separate from Scout relevance.
tasks.acceptance: Show the profile evidence behind every supported requirement; do not invent an ATS probability.

tasks.title: Evaluate matching accuracy
tasks.detail: Compare Matcher decisions against reviewed examples and measure missed requirements and unsupported matches.
tasks.acceptance: Review representative roles before using Matcher decisions in unattended drafting.

tasks.title: Configure a drafting model
tasks.detail: Choose a separately configured model provider or local model. The Keenable key supplies search only.
tasks.acceptance: Keep model credentials server-side and enforce model usage limits.

tasks.title: Draft a tailored resume
tasks.detail: Select relevant approved achievements, reorder content and use accurate job terminology.
tasks.acceptance: Create a versioned draft and visible changes without inventing experience or qualifications.

tasks.title: Check every resume claim
tasks.detail: Check dates, employers, qualifications, skills, figures and claims against the approved career profile.
tasks.acceptance: Flag unsupported content and require correction before the draft is ready.

tasks.title: Validate document and ATS readability
tasks.detail: Generate a clear document, extract its text and inspect reading order, sections and missing information.
tasks.acceptance: Verify a readable document and supported requirement coverage; do not promise a universal ATS pass.

tasks.title: Review and approve application packages
tasks.detail: Present the job, fit reasons, gaps, resume draft and highlighted changes for your review.
tasks.acceptance: You can approve, hold or skip and open the original application link.

tasks.title: Record your applications
tasks.detail: Track approved, applied, interview, rejected and withdrawn states with the exact resume used.
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish already shown from already applied and prevent repeat application prompts.

tasks.title: Learn from application outcomes
tasks.detail: Use reviewed feedback and outcomes to improve preferences and future drafts.
tasks.acceptance: Changes remain explainable and are grounded in recorded outcomes.

validation.title: Search release: automated checks
validation.detail: 64 tests, TypeScript and production build passed. These are recorded release results, not tests rerun by this dashboard.

validation.title: Search release: hosted checks
validation.detail: 15 HTTP checks passed. Portfolio Analyst / USA returned 24 leads, three with application-page evidence; one known closed role was excluded.

validation.title: Private access and secrets
validation.detail: Anonymous search access returned 401. Exact key scan found zero leaks across 213 source/build files; archive excluded .env and .git.

validation.title: Roadmap and progress view
validation.detail: 36 deliverables with dependencies. Five record/dependency tests and ten mocked component interaction checks passed; local page/API checks returned 200. Visual browser review remains outstanding. Daily scheduling and resume preparation have not been activated.
